given.note: K-02 v1.2's pair-unmapped-all-refused.json word for word, as the gate reads it (the named rule unmappedEndAsked compares the two files): Sam's 'Barbershop, plumbing, electrical' on S1-02's frontier (build-frontier-s1-02.json's context, K-02's context-s1-02.json), where the AI layer's validator refused both Haiku reads and the one Sonnet re-read (part 0 unmapped each time), so decide's result ends the whole turn in one question with no part (end oneQuestion; CQ-162 (a)). The request's turn carries the service and the Linq chat id of Sam's text, the stand-ins commit-s1-01.json gives his chat (README v1.5 default 135). The gate runs no limit, since no part is left to run one on, and the commit writes no row for the turn's parts: no picked kinds, no question, no outbox row, no effect and no key (README v1.8 defaults 142 to 144). It commits the turn under its id with Sam's text's safety outcome (No), which rides in the same commit as in any turn (README default 5), is named in its response and sends no line, so written, effects and openQuestions are all empty. The answer holds end asked: S1-02's question is asked once for the turn (default 145); its words and its row are CQ-199's (README v1.8 open gap 129).
